import builtins
from nuka.editor.app import ActionError
def fails(action, text, **args):
    try:
        app.actions.run(action, **args)
    except ActionError as e:
        assert text in str(e), (action, args, str(e))
    else:
        raise AssertionError((action, args))
def frames(n):
    for _ in range(n):
        app.update(True)
run = app.actions.run
links = ${links}['links']
base = links[0]['path']
hip = next(l['path'] for l in links if l['joint'])
builtins.sn_fails, builtins.sn_frames, builtins.sn_base, builtins.sn_hip = fails, frames, base, hip
before = run('sensor.list')
print('SENSORS_BEFORE', base, hip, before)
assert before == [], before
c = run('sensor.add', type='camera', mount=base, position=[0.28, 0.0, 0.05])
print('SENSOR_CAM', c)
assert c['index'] == 0 and c['name'] == 'camera_1' and c['type'] == 'camera' and c['mount'] == base and c['frame'] == 'body', c
assert c['camera']['width'] == 160 and c['camera']['height'] == 120 and abs(c['camera']['vfov'] - 60.0) < 1e-4, c
q = c['offset']['quat']
assert abs(q[0] - 0.5) < 1e-5 and abs(q[1] - 0.5) < 1e-5 and abs(q[2] + 0.5) < 1e-5 and abs(q[3] + 0.5) < 1e-5, q
assert abs(c['offset']['pos'][0] - 0.28) < 1e-6, c['offset']
l = run('sensor.add', type='lidar', mount=base, position=[0.0, 0.0, 0.12])
assert l['index'] == 1 and l['name'] == 'lidar_1' and l['lidar']['az_count'] == 64 and l['lidar']['el_count'] == 16, l
run('scene.select', path=base)
i = run('sensor.add', type='imu')
assert i['index'] == 2 and i['mount'] == base and i['name'] == 'imu_1' and 'camera' not in i, i
j = run('sensor.add', type='joint_state', mount=hip)
assert j['index'] == 3 and j['mount'] == hip, j
d = run('sensor.add', type='depth', mount=base, rotation_deg=[0.0, 30.0, 0.0])
print('SENSOR_DEPTH', d)
assert d['index'] == 4 and d['camera']['width'] == 160 and abs(d['offset']['quat'][0] - 0.9659258) < 1e-4, d
assert len(run('sensor.list')) == 5

import builtins
run = app.actions.run
s = run('sensor.set', index=0, camera={'width': 96, 'height': 72})
assert s['camera']['width'] == 96 and s['camera']['height'] == 72, s
listed = run('sensor.list')
assert [(x['camera']['width'], x['camera']['height']) for x in listed if 'camera' in x] == [(96, 72), (96, 72)], listed
s = run('sensor.set', sensor='lidar_1', lidar={'az_count': 32, 'el_count': 8}, rate_hz=10.0)
assert s['lidar']['az_count'] == 32 and s['lidar']['el_count'] == 8 and abs(s['rate_hz'] - 10.0) < 1e-6, s
s = run('sensor.set', index=0, name='head_cam', position=[0.3, 0.0, 0.06])
assert s['name'] == 'head_cam' and abs(s['offset']['pos'][0] - 0.3) < 1e-6 and abs(s['offset']['quat'][0] - 0.5) < 1e-5, s
o = dict(s['offset'], pos=[0.3, 0.0, 0.08])
s = run('sensor.set', index=0, offset=o, aov_mask=3)
assert s['aov_mask'] == 3 and abs(s['offset']['pos'][2] - 0.08) < 1e-6 and abs(s['offset']['quat'][0] - 0.5) < 1e-5, s
s = run('sensor.set', index=4, type='imu')
assert s['type'] == 'imu' and 'camera' not in s and s['mount'] == builtins.sn_base and s['name'] == 'depth_1', s
assert run('sensor.select', index=0) == 0
assert run('sensor.select', index=-1) == -1
print('SENSOR_LIST', run('sensor.list'))

import builtins
fails, base = builtins.sn_fails, builtins.sn_base
fails('sensor.add', 'imu sensors mount on a body', type='imu', mount='')
fails('sensor.add', 'no body at', type='camera', mount='nope/none')
fails('sensor.add', 'every camera renders one image size', type='camera', mount=base, camera={'width': 64, 'height': 48})
fails('sensor.add', 'unknown sensor type', type='sonar', mount=base)
fails('sensor.add', 'a joint_state sensor mounts on a joint', type='joint_state', mount=base)
fails('sensor.set', 'no such sensor', index=9, name='x')
fails('sensor.select', 'no such sensor', index=9)
assert len(app.actions.run('sensor.list')) == 5

import builtins
run, frames = app.actions.run, builtins.sn_frames
n = len(run('sensor.list'))
run('sensor.remove', index=4)
frames(4)
assert len(run('sensor.list')) == n - 1
run('edit.undo')
frames(4)
back = run('sensor.list')
assert len(back) == n and back[4]['type'] == 'imu' and back[4]['name'] == 'depth_1', back
run('edit.redo')
frames(4)
assert len(run('sensor.list')) == n - 1
run('sensor.select', index=3)
run('edit.delete')
frames(4)
assert [x['type'] for x in run('sensor.list')] == ['camera', 'lidar', 'imu'], run('sensor.list')
run('edit.undo')
frames(4)
assert [x['type'] for x in run('sensor.list')] == ['camera', 'lidar', 'imu', 'joint_state'], run('sensor.list')
builtins.sn_pre = run('sensor.list')

import builtins
pre, post = builtins.sn_pre, app.actions.run('sensor.list')
print('SENSOR_REOPEN', post)
key = lambda x: (x['name'], x['type'], x['mount'], x.get('camera', {}).get('width'), x.get('lidar', {}).get('az_count'))
assert [key(x) for x in pre] == [key(x) for x in post], (pre, post)
for a, b in zip(pre, post):
    assert all(abs(u - v) < 1e-6 for u, v in zip(a['offset']['pos'] + a['offset']['quat'], b['offset']['pos'] + b['offset']['quat'])), (a, b)
    assert abs(a['rate_hz'] - b['rate_hz']) < 1e-6, (a, b)

import builtins
run, frames = app.actions.run, builtins.sn_frames
r = run('scene.spawn', kind='box', pose={'pos': [1.0, 1.0, 0.3], 'quat': [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]})
print('SENSOR_SPAWN', r)
box = r['focus']
k = run('sensor.add', type='imu', mount=box)
assert k['mount'] == box and k['index'] == 4, k
frames(4)
run('edit.delete', path=box)
frames(4)
left = run('sensor.list')
assert len(left) == 4 and all(x['mount'] != box for x in left), left
run('edit.undo')
frames(4)
assert [x['mount'] for x in run('sensor.list')].count(box) == 1, run('sensor.list')
